justification: Standard: the public granny-flat tool stops showing a typed-in SEPP table (old clause numbers, figures stored nowhere, wrong instrument link) and shows the database's quoted standards instead; plus one new read-only ledger probe. No schema, no data write.

pre_impl.existing_data: housing_sepp_standards holds quoted secondary_dwelling rows for max floor area, principal private open space, three site-coverage bands and three CDC frontage bands. The tool's rear setback, side setback, 8.5 m height and 3 m separation exist in no table.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The typed table cited cl 4.18 and 'Sch. 3 Subdiv. 4', neither in the SEPP (Housing) 2021 in force, and linked to epi-2021-0649 instead of epi-2021-0714.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reuses the existing check route's database access; no new endpoint. The card is hidden when no rows load, never a typed fallback.
pre_impl.external_source_error: A failed query returns an empty list and the card is not shown.
pre_impl.frontend_type: sepp_standards is a new optional field on the check response; existing fields unchanged.

falsifiable_check.command: cd frontend-nextjs && npx tsc --noEmit -p . && npx jest canibuildit GrannyFlat ; cd .. && python -m pytest tests/test_housing_sepp_standards_readers.py tests/test_dq_probe_integrity.py tests/test_dq_check.py -q -o addopts=
falsifiable_check.fails_when: A reader of housing_sepp_standards without a fixed standard_type or approval_pathway filter fails the reader inventory; a probe outside the integrity rules fails test_dq_probe_integrity.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Observed 2026-10-10: tsc 0 errors, 110 Jest tests, reader inventory 3 passed, probe integrity 234 passed, ledger 43 passed. DQ-141 reads 1,336 live.

functions.name: GET canibuildit check sepp_standards
functions.input: the existing property check request, after the lot and zone have been resolved
functions.output: the quoted SEPP (Housing) 2021 granny-flat standards with clause and legislation link
functions.if_none: An error or no rows gives an empty list and the tool hides the card.

values.value: No regulatory figure in code; the typed table was removed
values.source: housing_sepp_standards rows that carry a source_quote
values.if_missing: The standards card is not shown.

queries.where_clause: development_type = 'secondary_dwelling' AND standard_type IN (...) AND numeric_value IS NOT NULL AND source_quote IS NOT NULL

break_it.scenario: The standards query fails or returns nothing
break_it.what_happens: The tool hides the standards card; no typed figure appears
break_it.how: empty list on error, card rendered only when the list is non-empty

break_it.scenario: A standard loses its quote of the law
break_it.what_happens: It drops out of the card instead of being shown unsourced

break_it.scenario: A new standard type is added to the table
break_it.what_happens: It is not shown until it is named in the query and given a label
break_it.how: fixed standard_type list; unknown types fall back to their raw name only if selected

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: run the public granny-flat tool on an eligible address and confirm the SEPP card shows database figures linked to epi-2021-0714 clauses.
